children: Fortis Healthcare Ltd on Wednesday said it has approached the Supreme Court against a forensic audit order passed by the Delhi High Court in the Daiichi Sankyo enforcement proceedings.
In a regulatory filing, the healthcare provider informed that it filed a Special Leave Petition (SLP) before the apex court on Wednesday.
Challenge to Delhi High Court order

The petition challenges the August 31, 2026 order delivered by the Delhi High Court in the case titled “Daiichi Sankyo Company, Limited vs. Malvinder Mohan Singh And Ors.” The Delhi High Court appointed a forensic auditor to examine the transactions of former Fortis promoters Malvinder Mohan Singh and Shivinder Mohan Singh in connivance with Fortis Healthcare Ltd, leading to dissipation of shares in connection with a Rs 3,500 crore arbitral award passed in favour of Japanese pharma major Daiichi Sankyo.

title: Fortis Healthcare files SLP against forensic audit order in Daiichi Sankyo case
